- The Orenda OE600 is a liquid-cooled 8-cylinder V-block aircraft piston engine in the 600 hp class.
- The Orenda OE600 was intended to reintroduce piston power to aircraft normally powered by the Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6 turboprop.
- Orenda Aerospace believed the Orenda OE600's better fuel economy would appeal to older aircraft whose existing engines were reaching the end of their lifespan.
